mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or CPI YoY > 2% does not correlate with subsequent tightening actions by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 in a month signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or PAYEMS drop does not correlate with subsequent economic slowdown.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real estate sales (HOUST) signals a strengthening demand side of the economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in expansionary periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals a weakening supply side of the economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or INDPRO drop does not correlate with subsequent economic slowdown.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises by more than 0.5% in 3 months, it signals a tightening monetary policy with labor market stress, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4% and UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or the interaction of high FEDFUNDS and rising UNRATE does not correlate with subsequent economic slowdown.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a month, it signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 5% and PAYEMS increases > 200k in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or the interaction of low UNRATE and high PAYEMS does not correlate with subsequent economic expansion.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) by more than 2% YoY signals a strong demand side of the economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, especially during an expansionary regime.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or GDPC1 increase does not correlate with subsequent economic expansion during expansionary regimes.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is rising and real estate sales (HOUST) are falling, it signals a supply-side mismatch, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or the interaction of rising INDPRO and falling HOUST does not correlate with subsequent economic slowdown.
